Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/ewbra8nv3nq3k27p/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Custodian Brothers [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Custodian Brothers v3.5.3 ## Intro The Custodian Brothers are the personal protectors of the Conduit, the heir of the Founder who created the gene-mods. Few in number, they use cutting edge armour and weapons, customized to their exact specifications. They serve as the Conduit’s personal guard and emissaries, delivering his orders and enforcing his will directly. The Custodians depend heavily upon their reputation and the trust that others invest in them. In order to maintain their status, they have slowly embraced intricate honour ceremonies, destructive rivalries and webs of lies and secrets. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story During his rise to power, the Founder established an entourage of trusted acolytes. Each member was an individual of intelligence and skill whom the Founder trusted implicitly. They were the first with whom he shared his vision for an enhanced humanity, and his plan to achieve immortality by transferring memories and consciousness to a clone upon death. The Custodian Brothers acted as his confidants and representatives, and their word is considered second only to the Founder himself. Throughout the civil war, they served as his personal guards and emissaries to the loyalist Detachments. When the Founder personally led a fleet to recover his stolen Flagship, the Custodians were at his side. They met the stolen ship at the edge of known space and a desperate battle ensued where the Founder himself was slain. Devastated by their loss, the Custodians fought with renewed fury, when at the height of the conflict, a wormhole opened and engulfed both fleets. The fleets then emerged in another galaxy, scattered and damaged. The Custodians moved quickly to rally the remaining Detachments of Battle Brothers and to enact the Founder’s contingency plan: the Conduit Program. The Founder’s foresight and knowledge was proven, as his consciousness and memories were preserved in a clone. The Conduit became a symbol of the Founder’s vision and victory over death, which united the disparate Detachments in Sirius, while the Custodians continued to serve as the Conduit’s right hand in the sector. The Custodians continue to serve a vital role as the right hand and voice of the Conduit to the followers of the Founder. As a result, Custodians value themselves and others according to the reputations they build, both within the Brotherhood and outside of it, above all else. To ensure their honour is recognized, each Custodian takes great pains to display signs of their achievements, keeping trophies and engraving their armour with titles. While some might dismiss the Custodians as vainglorious, most recognize that it is only through their tireless dedication and diplomacy that unity is maintained. The Custodians stand as symbols of the Founder’s singular vision and reflections of human perfection that exist at the edge of genetic modification. How will you defend humanity’s unity and honour in Sirius? 1 GF - Custodian Brothers v3.5.3 | Name [Size] | Qua | Def | Equipment | Special Rules | Cost | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Custodian Brothers v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Guardian:When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ## Special Rules Dash:Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Guardian Boost:If all models in this unit have Guardian, enemy hits always count as having AP(-1) from Guardian (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away). Hit & Run:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. Hit & Run Shooter:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting. Piercing Target:Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +AP(X) on their weapons when attacking it. Ranged Shrouding:Enemies get -6" range to a min. of 6" when trying to shoot units where all models have this rule. Reinforced:When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Shielded:Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Shred:On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Shred Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply). Steadfast:If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken. Tear:Against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+4). Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Versatile Attack:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ## Aura Special Rules Dash Aura:This model and its unit get Dash. Guardian Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Guardian Boost. Hit & Run Shooter Aura:This model and its unit get Hit & Run Shooter. Ranged Shrouding Aura:This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. Shred when Shooting Aura:This model and its unit get Shred when shooting. Steadfast Aura:This model and its unit get Steadfast. Stealth Aura:This model and its unit get Stealth. Unstoppable in Melee Aura:This model and its unit get Unstoppable in melee. ## Army Spells **The Founder's Curse (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Shred when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply). **Thunderous Mist (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits. **Focused Defender (2):** Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Unpredictable Fighter once (next time the effect would apply). **Dread Strike (2):** Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with Tear. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. **Guardian Protection (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Guardian Boost once (next time the effect would apply). **Mind Gash (3):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred. 3 GF -
